subject: general
question: 'The Race of My Life' is the autobiography of which Indian athlete?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Milkha Singh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Milkha Singh**, popularly known as **The Flying Sikh**, is the author of the autobiography titled **'The Race of My Life'**, which was released in **July 2013**.
 
• The book was co-authored with his daughter, **Sonia Sanwalka**, and provides a poignant account of his struggle during the **Partition of India**, his time in the **Indian Army**, and his rise to international athletics fame.
 
• He represented India in three consecutive **Summer Olympics**: **1956 Melbourne**, **1960 Rome**, and **1964 Tokyo**.
 
• Singh is iconic for his performance in the **1960 Rome Olympics**, where he finished **fourth** in the **400m final** with a timing of **45.73 seconds**, a national record that stood for nearly **40 years**.
 
• His life and the narrative of this autobiography served as the primary source for the **National Award-winning** biographical film **'Bhaag Milkha Bhaag'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e20068b61817b168623bbf4377a66602deb382bfb1e34ae29a5e35078dcefcb.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **P. T. Usha**:

 
 
• Known as the **Payyoli Express**, her autobiography is titled **'Golden Girl'**.
 
• She won **four gold medals** at the **1986 Asian Games** in Seoul and narrowly missed an Olympic medal in **1984**.
 
 
 
• **Abhinav Bindra**:
 
 
• He is India's first individual **Olympic gold medalist**, winning the **10m Air Rifle** event at the **2008 Beijing Olympics**.
 
• His autobiography is titled **'A Shot at History: My Obsessive Journey to Olympic Gold'**.
 
 
 
• **Neeraj Chopra**:
 
 
• He is an Indian **javelin thrower** who made history by winning the **gold medal** at the **2020 Tokyo Olympics**.
 
• He is the first Indian to win a gold medal in **track and field** at the Olympic level.
